text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well! Mile Championship, we meet at last!
choice_data_list: Is your head in the game?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You bet it is! All that's left is to run my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me. I oughta say howdy to Suzuka before the race starts.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: …On second thought, maybe I better not!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's my pal… but today, she's the rival I wanna beat more than anybody.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We'll leave the jawin' for after the race!
choice_data_list: Make it a race to remember!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Just ya wait! You and Suzuka are gonna be blown away by my super-charged running!
